setting.label: Remove blue-button remap
setting.help: Undoes this addon's keymap change - strips out just this addon's blue-to-ContextMenu entries from custom_remote.xml, leaving anything else in the file untouched. Deletes the file entirely only if nothing else was left in it. Run this BEFORE uninstalling this addon from the add-on browser - Kodi does not run any addon code on uninstall, so this is the only way to revert.
